title: Playground
subtitle: The intranet's own pieces, live. Poke at them.

overview.intro: A learning ground for how the intranet is built. Nothing here is a copy — every demo uses the same component the real page does, so what you see is what ships.
overview.drag: The physics drag from the sidebar editor, a board you can move cards across, and a file drop.
overview.design: The rules the interface follows, the colour tokens, a theme tuner, radii and type scale.
overview.components: Buttons, numbers, filters, empty states, dialogs, toasts, notification kinds, logos and a side-by-side German check.
overview.footnote: Nothing on these pages saves anything.
overview.motion: Tune the springs the interface really uses, and try swipe-to-reply and long-press.
overview.chat: A fake conversation built from the real chat pieces — send something and someone answers.

physics.title: Physics drag
physics.description: Lifts, swings with its speed like something carried, and flies into its slot on drop. Used wherever things get reordered.
physics.hint: Grab a row and pull. On a phone, grab the handle so the page still scrolls.

board.title: Moving between columns
board.description: Plain browser drag and drop, like the applicant board. The dashed slot shows where a card will land.

cards.logo: New logo on the login page

files.title: Dropping files
files.description: The drop zone attachments use. Drag files from your desktop onto it — here they're only listed, never uploaded.

principles.title: How the interface behaves
principles.description: The rules every page follows, so the intranet feels like one product.

hairlines.title: Hairline sections, not card stacks
hairlines.body: Group related rows in one bordered block with thin dividers instead of a card per item.

status.title: Status is never colour alone
status.body: A state always comes with an icon and a word, so it reads for everyone and next to chart colours.

dialogs.title: Creating opens a dialog
dialogs.body: Adding or logging something opens a dialog (a sheet on phones) or its own page — never a form sitting on top of a list.

saves.title: Settings save as you change them
saves.body: No save bars and no Save button at the bottom of a form. Flip it and it's done.

tabs.title: Tabs move to the bottom on phones
tabs.body: Pages with tabs use RouteTabs, which hands them to the bottom navigation on small screens.

pages.title: Big flows get their own page
pages.body: Editors, reviews and reports get a full page. Dialogs are for small, quick things.

colors.title: Colour tokens
colors.description: Use the token, never a hex value, so light and dark mode both work. Click one to copy its class.

status.title: Showing a state
status.dontWhy: Which dot means what? Colour alone can't say it, and not everyone sees it.

radius.title: Corner radius
radius.description: Small for controls, larger for surfaces. Click one to copy its class.

type.title: Type scale
type.description: A handful of sizes, used the same way everywhere.

samples.row: The main line of a row
samples.body: Descriptions and supporting text, kept short

tuner.title: Theme tuner
tuner.description: Change the accent and corner radius on the box below only. The CSS it would take appears underneath.

buttons.title: Button lab
buttons.description: Every variant and size. Pick a combination and the code updates with it.
buttons.presses: {count, plural, =0 {Not pressed yet} one {Pressed once} other {Pressed # times}}

milestones.25: Twenty-five. The button is fine, promise.
milestones.50: Fifty presses. You've earned a coffee.
milestones.100: One hundred. This button now trusts you completely.

badges.title: Badges
badges.description: Small labels for a state or a category. Pair a status badge with an icon.

kpis.title: Headline numbers
kpis.description: One joined strip instead of four cards. A figure that needs attention changes tone.

loading.title: Loading, then loaded
loading.description: Skeletons keep the shape of what's coming, so nothing jumps when it arrives.
loading.name: Advantis Group
loading.line: Everything arrived where the skeleton said it would.

filters.title: Tabs and filters
filters.description: Tabs split a list and show their counts; pills narrow it further. Both work on the list below.

empty.title: Empty states
empty.description: An empty list says what it is and offers the action that fills it.
empty.emptyHint: Collect what would make the office nicer.

settings.title: Settings rows
settings.description: Label left, control right, saved the moment it changes.

digest.title: Morning summary
digest.hint: One email a day instead of many

sounds.title: Chat sounds
sounds.hint: A soft ping for new messages

feedback.title: Dialogs, toasts and tooltips
feedback.description: Creating opens a dialog, results show as a toast, extra explanation sits behind a tooltip.
feedback.toastError: That didn't work. Nothing was changed.
feedback.tooltip: Longer explanations live here, not in the layout.
feedback.name: Name

panel.title: Overview panels
panel.description: What the admin overview is built from: a titled panel and rows with a tone.

notifications.title: Notification kinds
notifications.description: Every notification type something writes, with the icon and tint the list draws it with. A new type falls back to a plain bell until it gets one.

logos.title: Logo wall
logos.description: Integrations show their real mark, never their name in a box. It's where a quiet page gets its colour.

language.title: English and German side by side
language.description: The same components with the real copy at phone width. German runs longer, so labels that wrap or clip show up here first.

spring.title: Spring tuner
spring.description: Every animation here is a spring, not a timed curve. Start from one the intranet uses and drag the sliders to feel what each number does.

swipe.title: Swipe to reply
swipe.description: On a phone, pull a message sideways to reply to it. It snaps back either way; only a pull past the threshold counts.

press.title: Touch and hold
press.description: Holding a message opens its actions on a phone, where a small menu icon is too easy to miss.
press.hint: Press and hold for {ms}ms. Let go early and nothing happens.

chat.title: Chat lab
chat.description: The real bubbles, attachments, reactions and dividers with made-up messages. Send one and a colleague answers. Nothing leaves this page.

seed.morning: Morning! Who's in the office today?
seed.agenda: Agenda for Thursday is attached, budget is on OneDrive.
seed.link: Nice. Found this on the way in:
seed.linkDescription: An AI safety and research company.

replies.three: Can we talk about it after lunch?
